# Week 06 \- Lab 1: Bookstore API

## Chạy server

![][image1]

## Kết quả chạy thử curl

### 1\. Xem danh sách sách \- 200 OK

curl.exe \-i [http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books](http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books)  
![][image2]

### 2\. Thêm sách \- 201 Created

curl.exe \-i \-X POST http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books \-H "Content-Type: application/json" \-d "@book.json"  
![][image3]

### 3\. Xem một sách \- 200 OK

curl.exe \-i http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2  
![][image4]

### 4\. Sửa sách \- 200 OK

curl.exe \-i \-X PUT http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2 \-H "Content-Type: application/json" \-d "@book\_update.json"  
![][image5]

### 5\. Thêm và xem đánh giá \- 201 / 200

curl.exe \-i \-X POST http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2/reviews \-H "Content-Type: application/json" \-d "@review.json"  
![][image6]  
curl.exe \-i http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2/reviews  
![][image7]

### 6\. Giá âm bị từ chối \- 400 Bad Request

curl.exe \-i \-X POST http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books \-H "Content-Type: application/json" \-d "@book\_invalid.json"

![][image8]

### 7\. ISBN trùng bị từ chối \- 409 Conflict

curl.exe \-i \-X POST http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books \-H "Content-Type: application/json" \-d "@book.json"  
![][image9]

### 8\. Xóa sách rồi tìm lại \- 204 / 404

curl.exe \-i \-X DELETE http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2  
![][image10]  
curl.exe \-i http\://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1/books/2  
![][image11]
